0022600208.text: The Rockets (7-3, 2nd in the Southwest) are at home for their 11th game of the season against the Nuggets (5-3, 4th in the Northwest), with Houston riding a two-game losing streak after winning seven of its last ten. Houston is without Clint Capela (ankle sprain) and Steven Adams (calf strain), while Denver is missing Julian Strawther (knee sprain) and is listing Aaron Gordon, Cameron Johnson, Christian Braun, DeMar DeRozan, Jamal Murray and Nikola Jokic as day-to-day with game-time decisions. The teams have not met yet in 2026-27, but Houston lost the 2025-26 season series 1-3, including a 129-93 defeat in Denver on March 11, 2026.
